name: Audiobook Library
description: Plays audiobooks in a chapter-aware player styled after Audiobookshelf's. The now-playing bar shows chapter marks and the current chapter, with chapter skip, 10-second skips, speed and a chapter list. On phones, tapping the bar opens a full-page player.
overview: Chapter-aware audiobook player for Jellyfin's web client and apps

versions.changelog: Plugin skeleton with an empty dashboard page.
